capabilities.text: BROCA SMARTER Cognitive Architecture: Comprehensive reasoning, learning, and self-regulation system
Cognitive Dissonance Monitoring: Multi-dimensional self-alignment measurement (logical, factual, behavioral, goal)
Production Rule Reasoning: Goal-directed reasoning with working memory integration
Procedural Learning: Extract patterns from experience to create reusable procedures
Skill Management: Track proficiency and apply learned skills contextually
Signal Damping: Validation → clamping → outlier rejection → EMA → deadband → rate limiting → hysteresis
Emotional Intelligence: Affective state modeling, appraisal, and regulation
Self-Model CRUD Operations: Comprehensive self-awareness management
Memory Integration: Declarative memory for reasoning, spreading activation
Goal Management: Hierarchical goal pursuit and tracking
